overview: AutoHypixel automates the Hypixel minigame loop from chat alone: it parses S02PacketChat for the exact win/lose/die prompts and Limbo-spawn messages, then emits C01PacketChatMessage commands - the /play command for the configured Skywars or Bedwars mode after a game ends, /rejoin when spawned in Limbo, and 'gg' after a win (or a loss with Win Only off). A safety group disconnects when a staff ban is detected ('A player has been removed from your game.') by sending /l, or by flooding twenty bare '/' commands to force the Limbo server, then suppresses the resulting 'Unknown command.' spam for five seconds. The module gates itself on PlayerUtil.isOnServer("Hypixel") and hides its GUI settings otherwise.

sections.p: onPacketReceive matches S02PacketChat text against exact Hypixel prompt strings. 'You won! Want to play again? Click here! ' arms both the gg timer (unless Win Only suppresses losses) and the play timer; 'You lost!...' arms only the play timer unless Win Only is off; 'You died!...' arms only the play timer. Each match resets the relevant TimeUtil and clears the sent/gg flags. onPreMotion then flushes the queued actions: when timer.hasReached(playDelay + 0-100ms random jitter) and !sent it sends the /play command built by getJoinCommand() and sets sent=true; when ggTimer.hasReached(sendDelay + jitter) and !gg it sends 'gg'. onEnable resets all four timers and flags.

The dcOnBan branch watches for 'A player has been removed from your game.' - Hypixel's staff-ban broadcast - resets banTimer, and disconnects via the configured method: '/l' to return to the lobby, or the Limbo method which loops 21 iterations of a bare '/' C01PacketChatMessage to force the Limbo server. For five seconds afterward, any S02PacketChat containing 'Unknown command.' is cancelled (event.setCancelled(true)) so the flood's command errors never clutter chat. A dcOnVeloCheck branch that would disconnect on a suspicious S12PacketEntityVelocity is fully commented out, with a note that it cannot account for bows, snowballs and eggs.

onUpdateAlwaysInGui hides the module unless PlayerUtil.isOnServer("Hypixel") or the world is singleplayer, and onPreMotion toggles the module off with a notification when it runs off-server. getJoinCommand() maps the play mode to Hypixel's /play targets: solo_/teams_/ranked_ prefixed Skywars modes (solo_insane, teams_normal, ranked_normal) and the Bedwars queue names bedwars_eight_one, bedwars_eight_two, bedwars_four_three, bedwars_four_four, falling back to '/l'.

files.label: AutoHypixel.java
files.explanation: The module is a chat-driven state machine in one class. onPacketReceive matches S02PacketChat against Hypixel's exact win/lose/die and Limbo strings, arms the play/gg timers, triggers the ban disconnect (single /l or a 21-packet bare-'/' flood), and cancels 'Unknown command.' echoes for five seconds after the flood. onPreMotion flushes the queued /play, /rejoin and 'gg' commands as C01PacketChatMessage packets with randomized delays, and getJoinCommand() maps the settings to Hypixel's /play queue names.

files.label: PlayerUtil.java (isOnServer gate)
files.explanation: PlayerUtil.isOnServer("Hypixel") is the module's enable gate: it caches per-server results in a map, reads Rise.ip, and returns whether the current server's IP contains the given string. AutoHypixel uses it twice - to hide the module in the GUI (onUpdateAlwaysInGui) and to auto-disable with a notification when onPreMotion runs off Hypixel - so the server-name heuristic is the only thing separating the module from a spambot running on any server.

countering.label: Commands (command rate)
countering.explanation: Every action AutoHypixel takes is a command - /play, /rejoin, /l, and the Limbo escape's 21 bare '/' messages - so the whole module lives inside NCP's Commands check, which scores commands per second in data.commandsShortTermWeight and computes violation = max(nw - commandsLevel, shortTermWeight - commandsShortTermLevel). The Limbo flood is the clearest kill: 21 commands in one tick is an order of magnitude past any configured per-second level, and the check's short-term weight makes the burst unambiguous. The per-game /play + 'gg' cadence alone stays near the boundary, but combined with the flood the module cannot survive a server running Commands at default levels.

countering.label: Text (chat frequency)
countering.explanation: NCP's Text check scores every chat message into frequency buckets (data.chatFrequency, data.chatShortTermFrequency) and adds time-weighted penalties for repeats, post-join messages, and chat without movement, all over an 8-second window. AutoHypixel's 'gg' and /play commands are constant short strings sent immediately after game-end, which is the post-join/no-movement profile Text penalizes (textMsgAfterJoin, textMsgNoMoving), and the repeated 'gg' across games feeds the repeat-similarity score. Every command is also chat traffic, so the frequency buckets accumulate even when the command-rate check is disabled.

countering.label: Captcha (auto-armed chat gate)
countering.explanation: NCP's Captcha check arms a chat gate when suspicion accumulates: the player must reply with the answer to a server-generated question, and any wrong or missing answer repeats the question and raises the violation. AutoHypixel has no awareness of the captcha - onPreMotion blindly flushes the queued /play or 'gg' on its timer regardless of what the server is asking - so once Text or Commands arms the gate, the next scheduled command becomes a guaranteed captcha failure. The module's timer-driven flushing makes it unable to pause or answer, so the gate converts the automation into a self-sustaining violation loop.
